title: refactor(api): extract shared page math into a helper
body: The list and export endpoints each computed their page count inline; this moves the arithmetic into a shared pageCount() helper and switches both call sites over.

 # Changelog
 
+- Internal: extract shared page math into pageCount().
 - 1.4.2: fix export encoding on Windows.
